scope: Research and illustration-only prototype. The live game and production decks are unchanged.

recommendation.art: Use artwork with no printed rank letters, digits, or small corner suit indices. Keep the central ornamental suit motif and full-size illustration.
recommendation.values: Render rank and suit from game state as independent text at fixed corners. Use a fine warm-paper halo where art is busy, rather than a full-width header or a flat opaque patch.
recommendation.compact: Use a rank at upper left and a suit at upper right so both fit within the exposed part of a narrow stacked card. Mirror the pair at the bottom.
recommendation.scaling: Change label size independently from artwork scale. Keep labels visible in stacks and cap size to prevent 10 and its suit from colliding.
recommendation.limits: Most reference games show larger cards or icons than a ten-column phone solitaire board. Their visual hierarchy transfers; their exact sizes do not. Inspection is for secondary details, not a replacement for readable ranks at rest.

findings.observation: Elaborate frames distracted from attack, health and casting cost. The stated hierarchy became numeric values, title and art.
findings.borrow: Give gameplay values deliberate priority without shrinking the illustration into another frame.

findings.observation: The redesigned frame gives power/toughness a light box and stronger contrast, while reducing frame area to enlarge art.
findings.borrow: Use localized contrast around important values, not a large new banner.

findings.evidence: Visual observation of official press-kit screenshots
findings.observation: Illustrated playing cards retain familiar corner rank/suit locations and large central illustrations.
findings.borrow: Keep fixed corner anchors and the normal full card face.

findings.evidence: Developer quickbar article and its screenshot
findings.observation: Quickbar shortcuts show inventory counts over item icons. The screenshot uses compact high-contrast count labels.
findings.borrow: Let one visual asset coexist with changing values, using a fine outline for contrast.

findings.observation: Tactical health and danger information is visually distinct from the textured map.
findings.borrow: Give essential information a consistent, high-contrast treatment and recognizable shapes.

findings.observation: The game has a Card Detail view, and the June 2024 notes document corrections to text that was too small.
findings.borrow: Use a separate detail view for secondary information while keeping primary values readable on the board.

findings.observation: Players can change game text size independently. Subtitles also have scaling, color and background-opacity controls.
findings.borrow: Scale information independently from illustrations and keep contrast tunable.

evidenceLimit: These are visual observations and documented design choices. They do not establish the games' internal DOM, sprite, canvas or texture implementation. Independent text rendering is the recommendation for Kabale.

sampleAssets.description: Image-generator edit of existing J/Q/K sheet. Corner letters and small suit indices removed; central illustrations retained.
Image-generator art-only floral heart sample. It can be reused for several ranks because the values are a separate layer.

checks: HTML prototype rendered at phone width with no console errors.
Samples inspected for removed indices and retained illustrations.
No production app, engine, cache or artwork files changed.
